reason: I'd rather buy from a brand I already trust. The 240gsm organic cotton tee sounds decent, but I've never heard of Northline and 15% off doesn't make up for not knowing how the stuff holds up.
objection: I can't tell if it's actually good. There are no reviews, no wash-test photos, and nothing about returns or sizing. Online only means I can't feel the fabric first, and 'quality at fair prices' is what every new brand says.
would_change_my_mind: A pile of real reviews from verified buyers showing the fabric after a few washes, plus a clear free-returns policy. A friend I trust recommending it would also do it.
